startup_state.prior_execution_gates: E0-E6 recorded as endorsed; E7 not endorsed

observe.current_evidence: browser verification is triggered by broad push/PR events; P04 workflow also triggers on pull requests to main

understand.summary: The E-series is an execution-system capability program layered onto an already-automated repository. Several E capabilities overlap existing HomeFinder mechanisms, and the new E7 workflow duplicates CI orchestration. Broad existing browser triggers cause documentation-only commits to produce product-test runs and failure noise.

classify.ESR-001: E-series must treat preexisting automation as part of baseline architecture.
classify.ESR-002: homefinder-execution-gate.yml is a duplicate orchestration layer and is not justified as a second workflow owner.
classify.ESR-003: homefinder-browser.yml has broad triggers; repeated documentation-triggered browser runs are a workflow-boundary issue, not proof of product regression.
classify.ESR-004: AI_Key.yml has independent scheduled GitHub write behavior and must remain outside E-series authority until separately reviewed.
classify.ESR-005: E0-E6 completion claims should be interpreted as milestone capabilities, while program-level integration remains unreconciled until the existing automation surface is fully mapped.

planned_alignment: remove only the redundant E7 workflow introduced by this program
document the broad-trigger finding for a future bounded CI reconciliation
restate E7 as not endorsed until its enforcement design is integrated with the existing automation architecture
